summary: Scinai Immunotherapeutics filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release announcing that its wholly owned subsidiary, Scinai Biopharma Services Ltd., entered a definitive development and clinical manufacturing agreement with a U.S.-based, Nasdaq-listed biopharmaceutical company. The agreement carries approximately $5.1 million in committed base service fees for integrated CMC development and clinical manufacturing of an investigational oncology product, with development activity in 2026 and clinical manufacturing planned from January 2027. Committed Customer Orders reached roughly $7.6 million, up about 300% from $1.9 million at year-end 2025. This is an ordinary commercial CDMO contract, not a special situation.
